robust_alternative.note: Constriction-style robust setting (strong exploration/exploitation), useful when coefficient self-adaptation is disabled.

rationale: Multimodality detected (high info content / many attractors): increase social pull to help swarm consensus.
Narrow basin detected (small basin width): reduce inertia and keep enough cognitive pull for local refinement.
Many weakly connected local optima (sparse LON): favor stronger social attraction to avoid fragmented sub-swarms.
Short autocorrelation length: lower inertia to avoid overshooting in rapidly changing terrain.
High information content: emphasize exploitation pressure after discovery.
Very narrow basin estimate: further damp momentum and increase personal-best guidance.
